topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Group code of conduct and security acknowledgments; sanctions procedure (POL-01 4.8)
Board risk committee oversees cyber risk each quarter
Group CISO, division leads and the Division CySO with defined reporting lines (POL-01)
Hiring screening, TWIC for secure-area roles, annual training (96% of permanent staff)
Control owners named in the SSP and common control catalog; performance objectives for system owners
Inventory of the in-scope services (SYS-T6, hub partner routes for terminal customers) and data flows

control_description: Policies and responsibilities communicated to staff; annual acknowledgments
Terminal services agreements and portal terms describe services
control_owner: Marine Terminals director of customer services
gap: No system description and no written security and availability commitments to carriers and cargo owners; customers rely on questionnaire answers
remediation: Write the system description and service commitments; publish them to customers

control_description: Objectives for the customer data services set in the group risk program
Group and division risk analyses (P01) cover SYS-T6 and the hub
Fraud risks considered: fraudulent releases, appointment fraud, payment redirection (P01 MT-015, GR-07)
Change board assesses significant changes
gap: Onboarding of T7 to T9 to SYS-T1 in 2027 will change the system boundary; no assessment of its effect on customer commitments yet
remediation: Assess the Gulf migration against the system description before cutover

control_description: Group internal audit assesses common controls once and samples division controls (P07)
Deficiencies tracked in the POA&M and reported to the board risk committee

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Control selection from the High baseline and the common control catalog (P02)
General IT controls through SYS-G1 and SYS-G3 (identity, configuration baselines)

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Group policies and the Marine Terminals supplement (P06)

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: Role-based access in the TOS and SYS-T6; MFA for workforce
gap: The group logistics role lets 212 affiliate users see every customer's cargo, vessel and appointment data (P07 AC-3, AC-6; scenario gap 1)

control_description: Identity governance for workforce; customer administrators register their own users in SYS-T6
gap: Cross-division roles approved by the requester's own manager (P07 AC-2)

control_description: Quarterly certification; same-day termination
gap: Certification did not catch the group logistics role
remediation: Terminal general managers certify all roles on their data (POAM-001)

control_description: Data centers are the cloud providers' (carve-out); terminal server rooms under the FSPs
Group disposal service with certificates

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: WAF and bot protection in front of SYS-T6 and the hub; partner certificates
control_owner: Marine Terminals director of customer services
gap: MFA optional for about 4,200 trucking companies' users
remediation: MFA for cargo owner administrators by 2026-12-31 and all trucker users by 2027-03-31

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: AS2, SFTP and TLS for partner exchanges through SYS-G4
gap: 2 carriers still on plain FTP; hub routes not separated by division (P07 CA-3)

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on all servers; allowlisting on gate servers; file scanning on the hub

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Weekly authenticated scans; KEV tracking; configuration drift alerts

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: 24x7 SOC monitoring of SYS-T6, the hub and the TOS
SOC triage and case handling
Group IR plan and the P08 runbook
gap: No defined commitment for telling customers about incidents affecting their data; matrix not exercised (P07 IR-4, IR-6)
remediation: Customer notice commitments in the system description; cross-division tabletop (POAM-004)

control_description: Recovery runbooks for SYS-T6 and SYS-T1; restore tests each quarter
Change board, pipeline tests and release approvals for SYS-T6 and the hub
Contingency plans and manual procedures (P05)

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Annual vendor reviews for critical vendors
gap: The customer identity service and the managed file transfer software vendor have no SOC report on file for 2026
remediation: Obtain and review their reports; record complementary controls

control_description: Capacity monitoring and autoscaling for SYS-T6 and the hub
Immutable backups in provider B; warm SYS-T1 replica; WAF and denial-of-service protection
Quarterly SYS-T1 restore tests; SYS-T1 failover tested 2026-05
gap: SYS-G4 full rebuild and SYS-T6 failover to provider B never tested (P01 GR-12, GR-16)
remediation: Hub rebuild test by 2027-01-31; portal failover test by 2027-03-31

topic_label: Identification and maintenance of confidential information

gap: Hub message stores keep customer files indefinitely; no customer data retention commitment
remediation: Retention rule for hub message stores; deletion on contract end
